inbox.title: Notifications
inbox.emptyBody: Replies, due steps and finished work will show up here.
inbox.leads: {count, plural, one {# new job lead} other {# new job leads}}
inbox.leadsBody: From your job alerts, ready to look at

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Every company you’ve looked at, with all its jobs and your applications there.
companies.visit: Visit {name} website (opens in a new tab)
companies.watchingHint: New postings come to your Job leads
companies.noOverview: No overview yet. Open it to research the company.

empty.noWatching: You’re not watching any job board yet. Open a company and paste its careers page under “Watch their job board”.
empty.query: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try another search or clear the filters.
empty.filter: No company matches this filter. Try another search or clear the filters.
empty.title: No companies yet
empty.body: Each job you add brings its company here, with public facts and everything you’ve sent them.

company.title: Company
company.summary: {jobs, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}} · {applications, plural, one {# application} other {# applications}}
company.noJobs: No jobs or applications here yet. You can research this company first, then add a role when you find one.

overview.title: Company overview
overview.intro: Get to know {name} before you apply.
overview.how: Use {action} to have AI explain what this company does, using its website as evidence. You don’t need a job or application.

careersWatch.added: {count, plural, one {# new posting in Job leads} other {# new postings in Job leads}}
careersWatch.watchingBody: New postings on <link>{provider}</link> show up in Jobs → Job leads every few hours. Ones that clearly miss your search goals are skipped.
careersWatch.pasteHint: Paste their careers page ({providers}) and new postings come to you.

website.title: What’s {name}’s website?
website.once: It’s saved on the company, so you only do this once.
website.label: Website
website.hint: The company’s own site, like {example}. Not its LinkedIn page.
website.reason: Used to find work emails, research the company and show its logo.

add.title: Add a company
add.description: Paste its website or LinkedIn page, or just type its name.
add.name: Name
add.hint: With a website, Naruvi adds the logo and can find work emails for people there. A LinkedIn link only gives the name: Naruvi never reads LinkedIn.

companyFacts.title: Company facts
companyFacts.noMatch: No public record matched {name} yet. Adding the company’s website helps.

research.updatedBody: {count, plural, one {AI overview based on # page from {name}’s website.} other {AI overview based on # pages from {name}’s website.}}
research.nothingBody: The pages were readable but didn’t contain a usable overview, mission or values.
research.reason: Research reads the company’s own website for its overview, mission and values.
